title: Temple of the Feathered Serpent, Teotihuacan
scope: The excavated exterior of the Temple of the Feathered Serpent and its adjoining four-stage Plataforma Adosada in the Ciudadela at Teotihuacan.
limitations: The surviving excavation and visible ancient masonry are the scope. The larger Ciudadela precinct is mapped context only.
Individual carving losses and rubble stones are represented at medium fidelity. The relative elevation of the platform and unpreserved side details are approximate.
